CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D (4 threads). GPU: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT. PyTorch 2.12.0+rocm7.14.0.
Three shuffled rounds; 30 warmups + 100 timed passes per model per round; GPU synchronization enabled.
CPU: best measured mode from the same three offered modes. GPU: eager execution; native BatchNorm where present.
Excludes preparation, loading, transfers and output decoding. Batch-64 times cover all 64 images. FCNN timing pending.
